scope: Full source CI evidence; desktop CI is recorded independently. Synthetic CLI checks do not prove live platform pages or literary quality.

contracts: URL-free and structured permission refusals stop every existing-page probe stage without another route
unknown probe failures and malformed snapshots fail closed while denials for another origin never reopen a tab
permission denial on an existing target page is terminal without a fresh-page fallback
official origin permission denial during fresh navigation never attaches retries or leaks its URL
permission classification never attributes an explicit foreign origin or an incomplete phrase to the bound origin
management click or post-click permission URL and DOM failures never click again or fall back to navigation
approximate Runtime.evaluate errors and permission disconnected cancellation or closed codes are never retried
